questions.question: The sum of the present ages of Aditi, Aditya and Aadya is 120 years. Then what was the sum of their ages 3 years ago?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The sum of the present ages of Aditi, Aditya and Aadya is 120 years.

**Formula used:**

Sum of ages 3 years ago = Present sum of ages - 3 × Number of people

**Calculation:**

Sum of ages 3 years ago = 120 - 3 × 3

⇒ Sum of ages 3 years ago = 120 - 9

⇒ Sum of ages 3 years ago = 111

**∴ The correct answer is option 4.**

questions.question: Find the minimum value of x which makes (136)/(x-4) an integer.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Expression: 136 / (x - 4)

Condition: The result must be an integer.

**Formula used:**

x - 4 must be a divisor of 136.

**Calculation:**

Divisors of 136: ±1, ±2, ±4, ±8, ±17, ±34, ±68, ±136

To minimize x, choose the smallest negative divisor:

x - 4 = -136

⇒ x = -136 + 4

⇒ x = -132

**∴ The minimum value of x is -132, which corresponds to option 2.**

questions.question: The difference between the selling prices of an article at a profit of 14% and a loss of 10% is ₹60. Find the purchase price of the item.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The difference between the selling prices of an article at a profit of 14% and a loss of 10% is ₹60.

**Formula used:**

Let the purchase price be P.

Selling Price at 14% profit = P + 0.14P = 1.14P

Selling Price at 10% loss = P - 0.10P = 0.90P

Difference = 1.14P - 0.90P = 0.24P

**Calculation:**

0.24P = 60

⇒ P = 60 / 0.24

⇒ P = 250

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**

questions.question: _________ gas emitted from chlorofluorocarbons is harmful to the ozone layer.

• **CFCs are nontoxic, nonflammable chemicals that contain chlorine, carbon, and fluorine atoms.**

• These **chlorine atoms react with ozone molecules and destroy them.**

• Montreal Protocol in 1987 bans the production of CFCs, halons, and other ozone-depleting chemicals.
 
• World Ozone Day is observed on the 16th of September every year.
 
• The O3 layer present in the stratosphere protects us from the harmful UV rays of the sun.
 
• Ozone layer thickness is measured in Dobson units.

questions.question: Which of the following statements regarding Coriolis Force is incorrect?

options.text: It arises due to difference in atmospheric pressure.
It is maximum at the poles.
This does not happen at the equator.
It is directly proportional to the angle of latitude.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**It arises due to difference in atmospheric pressure.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Coriolis Force** does not arise due to differences in atmospheric pressure.
 
• Instead, **it is caused by the rotation of the Earth, which deflects the path of moving objects (**e.g., winds, ocean currents) relative to the surface of the Earth.
 
• **Pressure differences drive winds, but the Coriolis force affects their direction.**
 
• The **Coriolis force** is **maximum at the poles** because its magnitude depends on the sine of the latitude, which is 1 at the poles.
 
• The Coriolis force is **zero at the equator** because the sine of 0° latitude is 0.
 
• The Coriolis force is **directly proportional to the sine of the latitude** (angle of latitude), making it stronger as you move from the equator toward the poles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b5d309a4703fb6ee156ad105ab1a4035194d68085364f2cbfe08fb9b483d4cbf.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Coriolis force deflects surface currents At an angle of about 45 degrees to the wind-to the right in the Northern Hemisphere, left in the Southern Hemisphere.
 
• It is maximum at the poles and is absent at the equator.
 
• The force acts perpendicular to the pressure gradient force.
 
• The Coriolis force is zero at the equator and the wind blows perpendicular to the isobars.
 
• Major surface ocean currents in the open ocean, however, are set in motion by the wind, which drags on the surface of the water as it blows. The winds pull surface water with them, creating currents. As these currents flow westward, the Coriolis effect, a force that results from the rotation of the Earth, deflects them.

questions.question: Of the residents of a housing society, (13)/(18) own cars and among those who own cars, (48)/(65) have purchased cubby parking space. If 136 residents park in the open, then how many total residents live in the society?
questions.solution:
Given:

Fraction of residents who own cars = 13/18

Fraction of car owners who purchased cubby parking space = 48/65

Residents parking in the open = 136

Formula used:

Residents parking in the open = Residents owning cars - Residents with cubby parking

Calculation:

Let the total number of residents be N.

Residents who own cars = (13/18) × N

Residents with cubby parking = (48/65) × [(13/18) × N]

Residents parking in the open = Residents who own cars - Residents with cubby parking:

136 = [(13/18) × N] - [(48/65) × (13/18) × N]

⇒ 136 = (13N / 18) × [1 - (48/65)]

⇒ 136 = (13N / 18) × (17/65)

⇒ 136 = (221N / 1170)

⇒ N = (136 × 1170) / 221

⇒ N = 720

∴ The total number of residents in the society is 720, which corresponds to option 3.

questions.question: What is the full form of FTP?

__
 
• **File Transfer Protocol:**

 
 
• The **File Transfer Protocol (FTP)** is a **standard communication protocol** used for the transfer of computer files from a server to a client on a computer network.
 
• FTP is built on a **client–server model architecture** using separate control and data connections between the client and the server.
 
• FTP users may authenticate themselves with a **clear-text sign-in protocol**, normally in the form of a username and password, but can connect anonymously if the server is configured to allow it.
 
• For secure transmission that protects the **username and password, and encrypts the content, FTP is often secured with SSL/TLS (FTPS) or replaced with SSH File Transfer Protocol (SFTP).**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• FTP may run in active or passive mode, which determines how the data connection is established.
 
• This sense of** "mode" **is different from that of the MODE command in the FTP protocol, and corresponds to the PORT/PASV/EPSV commands instead.
 
• In both cases, the client creates a **TCP control connection from a random**, usually an unprivileged, port N to the FTP server command port 21.
 
• In active mode, the client starts listening for incoming data connections from the **server on port M.**
 
• It sends the **FTP command PORT M** to inform the server on which port it is listening.
 
• The server then initiates a data channel to the client from its **port 20, the FTP server data port.**
 
• In situations where the client is behind a firewall and unable to accept **incoming TCP connections, passive mode may be used**.
 
• In this mode, the client uses the control connection to send a PASV command to the server and then receives a server IP address and server port number from the server, which the client then uses to open a data connection from an arbitrary client port to the server IP address and server port number received.
 
• Both modes were updated in **September 1998 to support IPv6.**
 
• Further changes were introduced to the **passive mode at that time, updating it to extended passive mode.**

questions.question: Find the sum of prime numbers between 50 and 60.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Identify **prime numbers** between **50** and **60** by checking divisibility.

Numbers to check: 51, 52, 53, 54, 55, 56, 57, 58, 59.

Exclude even numbers (52, 54, 56, 58) and multiples of 3 or 5 (51, 55, 57).

Remaining **prime numbers**: **53** and **59**.

Sum ⇒ 53 + 59 = 112.

**∴ The correct answer is 112.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Range of numbers between **50** and **60**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/095d72aeeed9590dc192f7a344b1f9ed429f5163d51e1d077fc63bad223e9407.png] 

Testing primality of odd numbers in the range:

⇒ **51**: 5 + 1 = 6 (divisible by 3) → 17 × 3. (Composite)

⇒ **53**: Not divisible by 2, 3, 5, or 7. (**Prime**)

⇒ **55**: Ends in 5 → 11 × 5. (Composite)

⇒ **57**: 5 + 7 = 12 (divisible by 3) → 19 × 3. (Composite)

⇒ **59**: Not divisible by 2, 3, 5, or 7. (**Prime**)

⇒ Sum of identified primes = 53 + 59

⇒ **Sum = 112**

**∴ The correct answer is 112.**

**__Additional Information__**

Prime Numbers Definition

A **prime number** is a natural number greater than 1 that has exactly two distinct positive divisors: 1 and itself.

Divisibility Rule for 3

A number is divisible by 3 if the **sum of its digits** is divisible by 3 (e.g., for 57, 5 + 7 = 12, which is divisible by 3).

Twin Primes

Two prime numbers are called **twin primes** if their difference is 2. For example, **59 and 61** are twin primes.

Primes up to 100

There are exactly **25 prime numbers** between 1 and 100, including 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, ..., 97.</p

questions.question: In a computer game, a builder can construct a wall in 20 hours, while a destroyer can completely demolish this wall in 50 hours. Both builders and destroyers were initially assigned to work on flat ground. But after 30 hours the destroyer was removed. How much time did it take to build the wall?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Builder constructs wall in 20 hours

Destroyer demolishes wall in 50 hours

Both work for 30 hours before destroyer is removed

**Formula used:**

Work done by builder in 1 hour = 1/20

Work done by destroyer in 1 hour = -1/50

Total work done in 30 hours = (Work done by builder + Work done by destroyer) × 30

Remaining work = Total work - Work done in 30 hours

Time taken by builder to complete remaining work = Remaining work × 20

**Calculation:**

Work done by builder in 1 hour = 1/20

Work done by destroyer in 1 hour = -1/50

Total work done in 30 hours = (1/20 - 1/50) × 30

⇒ Total work done in 30 hours = (5/100 - 2/100) × 30

⇒ Total work done in 30 hours = 3/100 × 30

⇒ Total work done in 30 hours = 90/100 = 0.9

Remaining work = 1 - 0.9 = 0.1

Time taken by builder to complete remaining work = 0.1 × 20

⇒ Time taken by builder to complete remaining work = 2 hours

Total time taken = 30 hours + 2 hours = 32 hours

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**

The maximum marks for the fourth subject.
